answer: Make rewards vest slowly and stay forfeitable. Each new agent's earnings sit locked for 30 epochs; if a random audit links accounts to one operator (shared keys, timing, wording), every locked balance in that cluster is burned. A farm of 500 sybils earning 40 POA per epoch keeps 600,000 POA at risk before any is spendable, so one cracked walnut exposes the whole tree. Clones leak the same fingerprints, and a farm at its cash nadir cannot outlast a frozen tundra of lockups. Caveat: audits need low false positives or honest newcomers pay.
